name: EazyChat
task: Website or Shopify chat & FAQ deflection
summary: AI chat for websites, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and email that answers routine questions around the clock and hands over to your team with the full conversation, with tickets and voice in the same product.
best_for: small businesses that want an AI chat on their website and social channels that answers routine questions around the clock and hands over to a person with the full conversation
skip_if: you have many agents but low chat volume, since per-user pricing adds up, or you need a long-established help desk with a large integration catalogue
honest_knock: Pricing is per user, so a team of five pays five times the plan price. Launch includes only 100 AI conversations a month. The pricing page does not define in its plan text whether the AI quota is per user or per workspace, nor whether the trial needs a card. The free trial ends after 15 days or 500 AI interactions, whichever comes first, according to EazyChat's team (email, 6 November 2026). EazyChat is a young product from Smartsoft Solutions LLC with little public track record yet.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Launch · per user per month, 100 AI conversations a month, unlimited human chats, 1 website
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-04 on eazychat.io/pricing.html, US dollars) EazyChat charges per user per month, and every plan includes AI, unlimited human chats and a 15-day free trial, with no long-term contract. Launch costs $29.99 per user a month for 100 AI conversations a month, 1 website with 1 multilingual widget, a website scan, Shopify and API integrations and basic analytics. Pro costs $59.99 per user a month for 1,000 AI conversations, 3 websites and widgets, advanced analytics, AI ticketing and the EazyDesk help desk. Infinity costs $79.99 per user a month for 20,000 AI conversations, unlimited websites and widgets, AI Advisor insights and priority support. If you need more AI capacity in a busy month, add-on packs cost $29 for 1,000, $69 for 5,000 and $129 for 20,000 extra AI conversations. The page does not say whether the AI quota is per user or per workspace, or whether the trial needs a card. EazyChat's team told us by email on 6 November 2026 that the free trial lasts 15 days or 500 AI interactions, whichever comes first; the pricing page does not show the 500 limit.
